item.title: The Corner Store Brings Its New York Experience to the Las Vegas Strip
item.description: [Bloomberg] Catch Hospitality Group is opening a Las Vegas location of The Corner Store at the Cosmopolitan. Co-Founder and Partner Eugene Remm says the 150-seat restaurant will preserve the intimacy and authentic SoHo experience of its 75-seat New York original, rather than offer a Vegas-specific or watered-down version. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Elanco Shares Jump After Q3 Beat and Outlook Raise
item.description: [Bloomberg] Elanco Animal Health shares rose nearly 8% after the company reported third-quarter earnings above expectations and raised its full-year outlook. Jeff Simmons, Elanco’s President and CEO, called it a high-quality quarter, citing 11% reported growth and broad strength across markets and product lines. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Kailey Leinz on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Sweetgreen CEO Says Sales Rebound After Cyclospora-Related Traffic Drop
item.description: [Bloomberg] Sweetgreen CEO and Co-Founder Jonathan Neman says that sales momentum has improved after a summer Cyclospora outbreak—unrelated to Sweetgreen’s stores but damaging to traffic across the sector. The company reported October comparable sales growth of about 5%, following a return to flat comps in September, and saw further improvement in early November. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Kailey Leinz on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: FIGS Beats Earnings as Demand Outstrips Supply, CEO Trina Spear Says
item.description: [Bloomberg] FIGS reported third-quarter top- and bottom-line results above expectations, with revenue of $190.7 million versus an estimate of $182.8 million. The company logged a fourth consecutive quarter of at least 25% revenue growth; non-scrubwear revenue rose 35%, and international revenue also increased. CEO and co-founder Trina Spear said health care professionals are expanding their FIGS purchases beyond scrubs to items such as underscrubs, compression socks and outerwear, for work and off-duty wear. She speaks with Romaine Bostick & Kailey Leinz on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: AI-Generated Movie Heading Theaters
item.description: [Bloomberg] Artificial intelligence is moving from experimental videos to the big screen. Fable Studio CEO Edward Saatchi says a team of just 30 people spent nine months creating Gods Don’t Give Gifts, an AI-generated animated feature that still relies on human directors, writers, voice actors and artists. He joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss how AI changes the filmmaking process and what it means for Hollywood's traditional production model. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Providing Capital to Tech Companies: Masters In Business with Ann Berry
item.description: [Bloomberg] Barry speaks with Ann Berry, founder and managing partner of Threadneedle. They discuss her path from Goldman Sachs M&A and private equity to running a hospitality services company through the pandemic. They also discuss Ann's early-stage bets on AI and deepfake detection, and surveying the expanding IPO landscape. (Source: Bloomberg)
